questions.question_text: What is a core principle of academic integrity, as discussed in the chapter?

options.text: Copying others’ work to save time on assignments
Being honest, fair, and responsible in your schoolwork
Submitting work without citing any sources
Only focusing on getting high grades regardless of methods

correct_answer.text: Being honest, fair, and responsible in your schoolwork

questions.question_text: Which of the following is an example of plagiarism, according to the chapter?

options.text: Quoting a source on “Indian Economy” with proper citation in your essay
Rewriting a YouTube video’s ideas on “Best Laptops under ₹30,000” without giving credit
Writing an original essay based on your own research and thoughts
Mentioning a friend’s idea in a project with their permission and a shoutout

correct_answer.text: Rewriting a YouTube video’s ideas on “Best Laptops under ₹30,000” without giving credit

questions.question_text: What is a key aspect of the ethical use of information and ideas, as explained in the chapter?

options.text: Using others’ work without mentioning them to make your project look original
Giving credit to creators through citations or mentions when using their content
Only using your own ideas without ever referencing external sources
Copying exact paragraphs from websites to improve your writing

correct_answer.text: Giving credit to creators through citations or mentions when using their content

questions.question_text: How can honestybedemonstrated in academic collaboration, based on the chapter’s guidance?

options.text: Letting one teammate do all the work while claiming equal credit
Contributing fairly to group tasks and clearly defining each person’s role
Copying a teammate’s ideas without acknowledging their input
Avoiding group work entirely to ensure individual honesty

correct_answer.text: Contributing fairly to group tasks and clearly defining each person’s role
